# Use a standard Ubuntu base image, suitable for compiling C++ and Fortran code
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set a non-interactive frontend for package management to avoid prompts
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, dependencies for LAMMPS, and MPI
# build-essential: Compiler toolchain (gcc, g++, make)
# cmake: Build system generator for LAMMPS
# git: To clone the LAMMPS source code
# gfortran: Required by some LAMMPS packages, including reaxff
# libfftw3-dev: FFTW3 library for fast fourier transforms, a common dependency
# openmpi-bin, libopenmpi-dev: OpenMPI library and development headers
# python3: [FIX] Added to satisfy the LAMMPS build system dependency
# ca-certificates: Required for secure network communications (e.g., git clone over https)
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    cmake \
    git \
    gfortran \
    libfftw3-dev \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    openmpi-bin \
    python3 && \
    # Clean up apt cache to reduce image size
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Clone the latest version of LAMMPS source code into a temporary directory
# --depth 1 performs a shallow clone, which is faster and smaller
RUN git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/lammps/lammps.git /tmp/lammps

# Create a working directory for the application runs
RUN mkdir -p /app
WORKDIR /app

# Per instructions, ensure files from the 'reaxff/HNS' example are in the WORKDIR.
# This is done by copying them from the cloned source before it's deleted.
RUN cp /tmp/lammps/examples/reaxff/HNS/* .

# Configure, build, and install LAMMPS from source in a single RUN layer to optimize image size
RUN cd /tmp/lammps && \
    mkdir build && \
    cd build && \
    # Configure the build with CMake
    # BUILD_MPI=on: Enable MPI support
    # PKG_REAXFF=on: Enable the ReaxFF package as requested
    # CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX: Specify a clean installation directory
    cmake ../cmake \
      -D BUILD_MPI=on \
      -D PKG_REAXFF=on \
      -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr/local/lammps && \
    # Compile using all available processor cores
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    # Install the compiled binaries and libraries
    make install && \
    # Clean up the source and build directories to keep the final image lean
    cd / && rm -rf /tmp/lammps

# Add the LAMMPS binary directory to the system's PATH environment variable
# This ensures the 'lmp' executable can be called directly without specifying its full path
ENV PATH=/usr/local/lammps/bin:$PATH

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes
# These settings improve stability and performance by guiding MPI on which network interfaces to use (or ignore)
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none \
    OMPI_MCA_btl_tcp_if_exclude=lo,docker0 \
    OMPI_MCA_pml=ob1

# Set the default command to show LAMMPS help.
# This serves as a quick verification that the installation was successful.
CMD ["lmp", "-h"]

  name: lammps-reax-mc
  namespace: default
spec:
  cleanup: false
  containers:
  - command: lmp -v x 2 -v y 2 -v z 2 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite
    image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax
    launcher: false
  flux:
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  pod:
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: hpc7g.16xlarge
  size: 1
  tasks: 64

flux-minicluster-manifest.item:
# MiniCluster manifest for a LAMMPS ReaxFF experiment on AWS CPU instances.
# This manifest defines a single-node Flux job.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # The name of the MiniCluster instance.
  name: lammps-reax-mc
  # Deploying to the 'default' namespace as requested.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The number of pods in the MiniCluster job. Set to 1 for a single-node run.
  size: 1
  # The total number of MPI ranks for the job. Flux will run the command with this many tasks.
  tasks: 4

  # Keep pods and logs after the job finishes for debugging.
  cleanup: false

  # Enable strict validation for the MiniCluster spec.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # The container that will run the LAMMPS application.
  containers:
    - image: "ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax"
      # The command to execute within the Flux instance. 'flux run' is prepended by the operator.
      command: "lmp -v x 2 -v y 2 -v z 2 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite"
      # This container is not the designated launcher process, as per instructions.
      launcher: false
      # Note: No resource requests or limits are set, allowing the pod to be 'Burstable'
      # and use available node resources.

apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: lammps-reax-mc
  namespace: default
spec:
  cleanup: false
  containers:
  - command: lmp -v x 2 -v y 2 -v z 2 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite
    image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax
    launcher: false
  flux:
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9
  logging:
    strict: true
  pod:
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: hpc7g.16xlarge
  size: 1
  tasks: 64
